approval: Current canonical raster matrix. Strict four-neighbor RGB failures remain recorded separately. The declared edge-fringe policy accepts only exact hard-ink bounds, centroid delta <=0.5 physical pixels, and each reported nonedge RGB difference <=1 channel step within Chebyshev distance2 physical pixels of an actual color edge. All nonedge differences must be enumerated; no global RGB tolerance.
